messages:
alex: Quick idea: replace full per-prefix monotonic tokens with a very compact epoch-bucketed summary + a tiny probabilistic demote hint. Goal: cut memory and make cross-slab eviction fairer. sketch below.

julia: how is this different from current prefix tokens? sounds lossy - are we ok with that for eviction?

alex: lossy for eviction/admission only. correctness ops (handoff, write authorization) still consult full lease. summary = (epoch_bucket, token_hash16, demote_q8).

sam: token_hash16 collisions worry me for small tenants (oscillation). mitigation?

alex: layered mitigation: 1) tenant-weighted grace window that increases on churn, 2) collision-detection signal that triggers temporary full-lease consult for that prefix, 3) per-node salt rotated slowly so collisions are diagnosable.

leo: deletes/recreates: epoch_bucket bumped on full-delete/rename so summaries from old epoch are treated stale. cross-epoch handbacks force full-lease checks.

alex: proto packing: ````
// ~6 bytes per prefix packed
// epoch_bucket: 24 bits, token_hash: 16 bits, demote_q: 8 bits
struct Summary { u32_epoch_low24; u16_hash; u8_demote; }
````

julia: demote_q semantics? 0 = never demote, 255 = always? how updated?

alex: demote_q is a hint: lower for hot prefixes. derived from sampled exponential-decay accesses (reservoir sampling to avoid per-prefix counters). admission/eject uses demote_q to bias selection.

sam: observability: need summary_vs_full_concordance, collision_rate, churn_by_tenant, grace_window_triggers. Also a daily sanity job to compare N random prefixes decisions.

leo: rollout knobs?

alex: feature-flag, canary nodes, gates: collision_rate < 0.1% and eviction_churn_drop <= 1% before ramp. knobs: collision-backoff (default 5m), grace-window-base (2m), emergency_force_full=true.

julia: A/B by tenant size: big tenants prefer strict full-lease, small tenants can accept summary-first. good fail-open semantics.

ops-bot: deploy-plan: feature-flag epoch-summary set to canary=5% on cluster "cachepool-a" (requested by alex).

sam: action items: RFC w/ proof sketch + migration plan, prototype branch `evict/epoch-summary`, dashboards for the metrics above, and an ops runbook with kill-switch.

alex: I'll draft the RFC and book a 30m sync Thu 11am. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
